svg.title: GitHub Stats
svg.desc: Weighted Voronoi map of JonatasCortes's repositories: each territory is a language and each cell is a repository, with area proportional to the amount of code. Brightness shows how recent the last push was. On the right, weekly activity for the last 12 months.

text.tspan: each one represents a programming language.
each one represents a GitHub repository within a programming language.
proportional to the amount of code in the repository.
proportional to how recently the repository was last pushed to.
